job.structural_change: A2 10-14: PARK wide1 verdicts: Q0/Q1 GRT-0116 with residual overflow only on the GCell (0.57 um grid, origin 0) that straddles each SRAM pin face (col0 W 22.464 -> 23% of that GCell outside the macro at E 117.288, 41% at W); Q2/Q3 routed but DRC 20/16 = M4 Short/Metal Spacing at the SRAM pin faces (x 117.0-117.25, 251.14) = the over-macro M5 track jog through the macro OBS that physical/common_flow/macro_edge_via_guard.tcl was written for (cured lane12). Structural: macro x origins moved on the 0.432 lattice so every pin face sits 0.41-0.53 um into its GCell from the channel side (col x 23.328/157.248/291.168: W faces 0.528/0.498/0.468 um, E faces 0.408/0.438/0.468 um of the straddling GCell outside the macro, was 0.234/0.132/0.204); channels 39.096 um (cut 0.60), margins 23.33/22.25 um (0.53); plus the SRAM edge guard. Same RTL, outline, pins, benches.
job.purpose: Edge-guard successors edgeguard4 (Q0 39d815a78, Q1 469086ccd, Q2 ca768d5b8) all terminal GRT-0116 at ~22% usage: every residual marker (Q0 39, Q2 25) is capacity-0 at a SRAM pin face that opens onto an inter-macro channel (x 118.6-120.3 inside col0 E face, x 143.1-145.4 inside col1 W face, x 26.2-28.5 col0 W face); the guard removed edge capacity and did not help. Cut arithmetic: each 128x256 SRAM has 412 W + 409 E M4 pins on its 41.04 um faces, so each inter-column channel absorbs 821 pin escapes per bank row; at 21.82 um the channel's effective vertical supply (M3 27.8 + M5 20.8 tr/um x GRT 0.744 x PG 0.964) is 34.8 tr/um x 21.82 = 759 tracks: ratio 821/759 = 1.08 > 0.60. Re-shape: channels 39.10 um (821/(39.10 x 34.8) = 0.60), outer margins 22.46/23.11 um (412/(22.46 x 34.8) = 0.53); macro x origins 22.464/156.384/290.304 on the 0.432 lattice, rows unchanged; outline 408.24 x 302.4 (+3.3 % width). Edge guard dropped. Same RTL, 12 SRAMs, FIFO512x545, clock/reset/data epochs, benches; each queue keeps its measured-positive pin window.
